title: app-shell(metadata-admin): the translation preview's category list has drifted from TranslationDataSchema — a spec-valid bundle of only pages or picklists reads "empty", and two refused groups count toward coverage
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, class (b), contract against renderer. The reach is measured on the real component. Reader: objectui triage first-touch (grade and route).
Dedupe (MCP `search_issues`, objectui, open + closed):
- "translation preview categories drift from TranslationDataSchema: pages picklists datasets flows missing, validationMessages settings removed, empty bundle coverage" gave 14 hits. objectui#11755 is the positive control: this preview's other card, the same file and the same seam. objectui#10235 (closed) is the console's bundle loader, a different reader. No hit covers this category list.
- "TranslationPreview globalActions object Object" gave 1 hit, objectui#11755.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat 3 (`session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`) from the objectui#11755 dev report (`6031597562`, out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## What happens

`TranslationPreview` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/TranslationPreview.tsx`) draws one card per entry of its `CATEGORIES` table. That table is not the group list of the schema the bundle is validated against.

Per-app `TranslationDataSchema` (`@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0, `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`) declares eleven groups: `objects`, `picklists`, `apps`, `messages`, `globalActions`, `dashboards`, `datasets`, `pages`, `flows`, `metadataForms` and `settingsCommon`. `CATEGORIES` lists eight:
- **five spec groups are missing:** `picklists`, `datasets`, `pages`, `flows` and `settingsCommon`;
- **two refused groups are listed:**
  - `validationMessages`, which the schema refuses as removed in 17.0.0 (ADR-0049);
  - `settings`, which the per-app schema refuses as a platform-only group. Only `PlatformTranslationDataSchema` declares it.

Measured by the dev on the real component (objectui `77c12b9`, installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0):
- A bundle whose only entry is `pages: { home: { label: 'Accueil' } }`, or `picklists: { stage: { label, options } }`, passes `TranslationDataSchema.safeParse`, and the designer's `validateMetadataDraft('translation', …)` answers `ok: true`. The preview still reads "This bundle is empty — add at least one translated string to see the coverage report."
- The coverage denominator is `CATEGORIES.length` (8), which counts the two refused groups. So a spec-valid bundle tops out at 6/8.

Seam: spec:TranslationDataSchema (eleven groups; `validationMessages` removed in 17.0.0; `settings` platform-only) → renderer:TranslationPreview (`CATEGORIES`)

## Done when

- The preview's categories are the groups of the schema the designer validates against. A spec-valid bundle of any one group reads as non-empty and shows that group's card. A group the schema refuses is neither drawn as a category nor counted in the coverage denominator.
- Pins: one bundle per newly listed group, each parsed by `TranslationDataSchema` in the test, reads non-empty with its card. A full spec-valid bundle can reach full coverage. The `messages` card renders as before (control).

Note for the claimant: the new category headings likely need `engine.translationPreview.category.*` keys in the published language packs. That is `Clause-②` work, which the objectui#11755 fix (`Clause-②: no`) did not take on. The same dev report notes that the en `engine.translationPreview.keyCount` reads `{1 keys}` for a single key, a polish item the claimant may fold in.
